budget_items.topic: Leominster Youth Lacrosse rate request for turf field
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The lacrosse group said the club's prior pricing was too steep and it hoped to get a deal at a lower hourly or daily rate.
budget_items.quote: they are hoping to work out a deal for $100/hour or $600 a day preferably less.

budget_items.topic: Field monitor cost and proposed turf usage fee for 8 Sundays
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Pete estimated a field monitor at $28+ an hour and thought a package of $6300 for the 8 weeks could be worked out, based on 56 hours at $112.50/hr with a 3-hour minimum.
budget_items.quote: pete said it would be $28+ an hour for a field monitor but that he thought we would be able to work out $6300 for the 8
